title: Add Theseus dashboard row ordering semantics

sourceRefs.summary: Adds status and node-kind ranks for deterministic dashboard row ordering.
Covers activity-first row ordering before stable id sorting.

progress.summary: Added explicit activity/status row ordering for dashboard work rows so active and in-progress items appear before ready, blocked, deferred, and resolved rows.
